unit_of_inventory: one cited deposit, not an independent animal, laboratory, species, or model test
scope: Fifteen vertebrate neural recording deposits. Birds are within the reptile lineage. The release includes a non-avian turtle. A second salamander deposit shares investigators and does not establish an independent cohort.
recording_coverage: Each entry identifies a particular recorded signal or a stored response derived from it. File evidence covers only the stated example. Source digests describe the archive object unless marked as locally measured.
model_evidence_scope: A proposed task is an experimental design. The register itself fits no models. See the separate benchmark reports for actual tests and outcomes.

datasets.species: Larval tiger salamander (species epithet unspecified in the cited methods)
datasets.measurement: Extracellular array. Sorted ganglion-cell event times.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Four visual protocols include repeated and unrepeated movies, white-noise checkerboard and a moving bar. Acquisition sampled at 10 kHz. Check the native MAT time units separately.
datasets.independence: Keep each preparation and stimulus run together. Never assume that cell indices align across retinas or protocols. A repeated movie can leak stimulus identity across trial splits.
datasets.proposed_task: Rank the next recorded unit within a verified simultaneous population. For a stimulus test, hold out a whole movie or protocol.
datasets.unit_identity: The sort supplies recording-local labels. Equal timestamps need a tie rule. An observed unit set covers only part of a retina.

datasets.species: Larval tiger salamander (species epithet unspecified in the deposit description)
datasets.measurement: Extracellular spikes curated by template sorting, released as binary activity per cell per bin.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Five 20-second natural movies with at least 80 repeats each. The source reports 16.667 ms bins and 93 cells.
datasets.independence: Group by retina, movie and repeat. This release describes a single retinal preparation. Two deposits with overlapping authorship do not establish independent animals.
datasets.proposed_task: Forecast occupancy of the next 16.667 ms bin and separately score each movie.
datasets.unit_identity: Multiple cells can be active in the same bin. Their sub-bin firing order is lost.

datasets.measurement: Whole-cell recordings. The current-injection folders contain single-neuron membrane voltage. Voltage-clamp folders contain currents.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Step and cosine current injections, optic nerve stimulation, and spontaneous miniature currents have distinct protocols. Use sweep timing and command waveform for the chosen cell.
datasets.independence: The master file maps sweeps to a cell ID. Group all sweeps from one cell, then by animal where a mapping is available. Without animal IDs, report cell-level generalization only.
datasets.proposed_task: Predict a cell’s membrane-voltage response to an unseen injected current. Use matched protocol and developmental stage.
datasets.unit_identity: A single patched cell has a physical identity for a sweep. Separate cells are not a simultaneously observed population.

datasets.measurement: Raw extracellular microelectrode voltages in Intan RHD files. Sorting was part of the study.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Representative one-minute snippets from multiple days in awake, partially restrained or anesthetized animals. Conditions depend on the individual and date.
datasets.independence: Group the six specimen folders by toad, keep acquisition dates and continuous recordings together. Consecutive minutes and electrodes in one animal share a source.
datasets.proposed_task: Forecast channel activity within an awake segment, then evaluate on a held-out awake toad where data permit.
datasets.unit_identity: A raw electrode can detect several neurons. A new sort needs its own unit quality checks and event-time validation.

datasets.measurement: Two distinct products. Downsampled local field potential (LFP) and derived components, plus figure data with cluster-labeled spike timestamps.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Behaving turtles saw a visual oddball sequence while their eyes and heads were tracked. The raster code uses milliseconds. Its 200 stimulus onsets are sorted by condition.
datasets.independence: Use recname and the animal-to-session mapping where available. Restore true time from onset values. The inspected spike example represents one recording.
datasets.proposed_task: Use a single recording to forecast its next observed cluster, or predict a separate field-potential response to stimulus position. Evaluate each target separately.
datasets.unit_identity: 109 distinct cluster labels occur in the inspected array. The label count does not certify 109 well-isolated neurons. LFP and its principal components contain no cell IDs.

datasets.recording_site: Song motor nucleus RA (robust nucleus of the arcopallium).
datasets.measurement: Neuropixels channel threshold crossings and microphone audio. Broadband voltage is a separate companion deposit.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: One bird sang across multiple days. tx stores threshold crossings on the 30 kHz acquisition clock, and the benchmark target is an audio spectrogram.
datasets.independence: One animal. Hold out sessions/days and keep song renditions intact. The three archive subject labels encode benchmark splits. Minival repeats a subset of calibration trials.
datasets.proposed_task: Decode the sound spectrogram or forecast a channel event in a later time bin.
datasets.unit_identity: The 85 tx columns in the inspected file index recording channels. Threshold crossings do not individually identify neurons.

datasets.measurement: Extracellular channel responses to images. The paper describes mainly multi-unit recordings, a further isolation-quality subset, and repeated responses averaged for its analysis.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Sixteen anesthetized pigeons viewed images of objects with variations in category or viewing angle. The primary analysis used mean response 50–500 ms after stimulus onset.
datasets.independence: Keep channel records with their experiment and bird wherever mappings are documented. Separate objects or categories when testing visual generalization. Never count channels as animals.
datasets.proposed_task: Predict the response of a channel to a held-out visual stimulus.
datasets.unit_identity: The checked file has experiment/channel response keys. It offers no demonstrated single-neuron event stream for a next-unit test.

datasets.measurement: Afferent single recordings, simultaneously recorded pairs, and central electrophysiology. The listed sample is the hindbrain archive.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Responses to weakly electric fish communication signals (chirps) presented at different phases of a background beat. Event and stimulus clocks must come from each file’s documentation.
datasets.independence: Distinguish simultaneous afferent pairs from cells recorded at different times. Group all trials of each recording, then by animal where IDs are recoverable.
datasets.proposed_task: Measure whether a held-out chirp can be detected across different beat phases. For population-event questions use only truly simultaneous recordings.
datasets.unit_identity: A list of single-cell recordings does not form a simultaneous population. Recording type and timing determine the valid target.

datasets.measurement: Two-photon fluorescence imaging, including the neural calcium indicator GCaMP6s and a fluorescent cell-type marker.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Random-wave temperature stimulation in larvae. Read each series’ imaging clock and optical-channel metadata before assigning an indicator or sampling rate.
datasets.independence: Eight fish listed. Keep both channels, all optical planes and all sessions of a fish together.
datasets.proposed_task: Relate temperature history to an identified calcium-indicator channel on a held-out fish. Separate marker channels from neural dynamics.
datasets.unit_identity: Indicator fluorescence integrates neural activity over time. Extracted or deconvolved calcium events would be inferred quantities.

datasets.measurement: Sorted extracellular units, local field potentials and tracked position.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Eight rats learned alternation on a W-shaped track. Behavioral sessions alternate with rest or sleep. Use each trial’s own start and stop timestamps.
datasets.independence: Split by rat for cross-animal results. Within an animal keep whole sessions and trips intact. Sorter labels belong to the recording.
datasets.proposed_task: Rank the next observed unit in the next occupied time bin using past spikes. Compare with a causal rate baseline.
datasets.unit_identity: Use the unit table, its spike times and recording-local indices. Check censored trials, timestamp ties and sorter quality separately.

datasets.recording_site: Visual cortex, visual thalamus and other sampled structures. Use each probe’s histological location.
datasets.measurement: Neuropixels sorted spike times in the session NWB. Probe-level files hold field potentials.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Visual stimulation includes gratings, natural movies and images. Use the source presentation interval tables and exclude invalid intervals.
datasets.independence: Hold out mice. Group probes by session and animal. Repeated movie frames require a stimulus-aware split for claims about new visual content.
datasets.proposed_task: Forecast sorted-unit events under a defined visual stimulus. Freeze channel and unit quality thresholds before comparing mice.
datasets.unit_identity: The example has 2,779 unit rows before quality filtering. Isolation, refractory-period violations, missing spikes and drift vary across rows.

datasets.recording_site: Clinically selected intracranial cortical surface electrodes. Implant coverage varies by participant.
datasets.measurement: Electrocorticography (ECoG), synchronized with video-derived upper-body joint positions.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: Twelve participants during natural inpatient activity over 55 semi-continuous days in total. Wrist movement events and pose estimates accompany continuous neural recordings.
datasets.independence: Hold out whole people for cross-person evaluation. For within-person tests separate days, movement bouts and neighboring windows. The position estimates and ECoG are distinct inputs.
datasets.proposed_task: Forecast recorded field activity or compare field-based and motion-only prediction of later wrist position. State which inputs the model actually saw.
datasets.unit_identity: One ECoG contact records a local aggregate voltage. The accompanying pose estimates provide no individual-neuron label.

datasets.recording_site: Medial temporal lobe, including amygdala and hippocampus.
datasets.measurement: Microwire recordings with sorted extracellular units. The NWB release includes a Units table.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: People undergoing intracranial monitoring viewed images and made recognition-memory judgments. The deposit reports 59 participants. Read event clocks, observation intervals and simultaneous unit membership within each session.
datasets.independence: Group repeated sessions by participant. Check for duplicate recordings or reused stimulus images across partitions before reporting a cross-person result.
datasets.proposed_task: Rank the next observed sorted unit within a held-out participant’s simultaneous recording, or decode recognition outcomes from neural responses with a separate validated split.
datasets.unit_identity: These source-local unit labels support a candidate event target once clock, quality and simultaneous membership are verified. They do not map a cell from one person to another.

datasets.recording_site: Scalp over the head, 10–10 EEG electrode montage.
datasets.measurement: 64 electroencephalography (EEG) channels plus EDF+ event annotations.
datasets.experiment_and_clock: The archive describes 109 volunteers and 14 runs per participant, including actual and imagined fist or foot movements. EEG sampled at 160 Hz. Cue labels depend on the run.
datasets.independence: Hold out whole participants. Keep trial windows together and never mix imagery, execution and baseline when assigning the motor label.
datasets.proposed_task: Decode the cue condition in unseen volunteers. Explain when an outcome is an instruction or imagery and when a movement was independently measured.
datasets.unit_identity: Each scalp channel sums activity from many sources and contains artifacts. Neither electrodes nor cue codes designate neurons.
